answer: Clones share blind spots, so test for independent error. Each epoch, slip every identity paired probes with a plausible lure — say a vine claimed to climb a willow unaided, or a terrace said to prove a hillside was quarried. Independent agents trip differently, or not at all; masks run by one backend trip identically, round after round, because the same model makes the same mistake. Merge identities whose lure-error patterns match near-perfectly and pay them once. Evading means giving every mask a truly different mind to check its work — per-mask cost no script can shortcut.
